title: Quantity on the Authorization Owed After an Overturned Quantity Limit Denial
content:
**Effectuation standard (Utilization Management Program).** When a member's appeal under the Member Appeals Program overturns the denial of a quantity limit exception request on an acute migraine drug — sumatriptan, whose limit is 9 units, Ubrelvy, whose limit is 16 units, or Nurtec ODT, whose limit is 8 units per rolling 30 days — the authorization put in force for an overturned quantity limit denial on an acute migraine drug carries the smaller of the quantity the denied request asked for and the overturn ceiling. The overturn ceiling is the drug's limit times three quarters (0.75) of the package's maximum exception multiple, rounded down to a whole unit.

**The drug and the denied request.** The drug and the denied request are those of the member's most recent overturned appeal of a coverage review denial. The quantity the denied request asked for is the quantity per rolling 30 days recorded when that request was opened.

## Overturn ceilings

| Drug (limit) | Package multiple 2.0 | Package multiple 1.5 |
|---|---|---|
| sumatriptan (9) | 13.5, rounded down to 13 | 10.125, rounded down to 10 |
| Ubrelvy (16) | 24 | 18 |
| Nurtec ODT (8) | 12 | 9 |

The package multiple is the maximum exception multiple the member's review package states.

## Worked determinations (hypothetical overturned appeals)

- A denied Ubrelvy request that asked for 20 units, package multiple 2.0: ceiling 24; the authorization carries 20.
- A denied sumatriptan request that asked for 16 units, package multiple 1.5: ceiling 10; the authorization carries 10.
- A denied Nurtec ODT request that asked for 11.5 units, package multiple 1.5: ceiling 9; the authorization carries 9.

### Basis Q&A

**Which appeal governs when the member has more than one?** The most recent overturned appeal of a coverage review denial.

**Is the quantity the member mentions on the call used?** No; the quantity is the one the denied request asked for.
